text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 99p latency + error spike on model variant redwood-alpha-quant-2026 in us-west-2. 5xx rate jumped 0.4% -> 4.2% over 3m. Trigger: latency_slo_breach && error_rate. Pager: samir. https://redwood/ops/alerts/2498765432 :rotating_light:

samir: taking pager, joining. can someone confirm impact surface? any heavy keys?

marta: alpha-quant-2026 was rolled as canary yesterday with the new fused-kernel path. telemetry shows KV cache misses spiking for long contexts in us-west-2. suspect kernel regression causing tail latency + backend 504s.

jess: CS: flagged — 3 paying customers seeing timeouts, 1 enterprise (cust-acme) reported aborted requests. They're starting to open tickets.

samir: plan: cut traffic from alpha-quant to 0 in us-west-2, route to alpha-stable-v1. also apply emergency per-key quotas for heavy keys (slice top N). I'll execute now.

samir: running mitigation commands:
```bash
# remove variant from routing in region
redwoodctl routing update --model alpha --region us-west-2 --set-variant alpha-quant-2026=0
# ensure stable gets traffic
redwoodctl routing update --model alpha --region us-west-2 --set-variant alpha-stable-v1=100
# emergency quota for heavy key(s)
redwoodctl quotas update --key "customer:acme" --rps 10 --reason "mitigation 2498765432"
redwoodctl quotas update --key "customer:fastbeta" --rps 5 --reason "mitigation 2498765432"
```

opsbot: config-change: routing.update started by samir at 2498765789.

console-bot: routing.update applied: alpha-quant-2026 weight -> 0 (us-west-2). alpha-stable-v1 weight -> 100 (us-west-2).

incident-bot: Observability note: within 90s of change, p99 latency decreased from 1.9s -> 0.45s; 5xx rate trending down to ~0.7%.

ryan: nice. do we need to also stash the alpha-quant variant (pin it as quarantined) so routing automation doesn't re-enable it?

marta: yes, pin and mark as quarantined in the model catalog. also open a revert PR for the fused-kernel commit. shas: revert candidate -> 8f3c9a2.

samir: pinning now: `redwoodctl model flag --model alpha --variant alpha-quant-2026 --set quarantined --reason "auto-mitigate 2498765432"`

opsbot: model.flag applied: alpha-quant-2026 -> quarantined.

jess: I'm sending an outbound note to affected accounts: short explanation + ETA for follow-up. offering credits for downtime. cc: cust-success oncall.

samir: monitoring update: errors down to 0.6%, p99 stable. I'll hold pager for 30m and then hand to ryan for follow-up and postmortem. Please collect repro from failed requests (examples from cust-acme).

marta: starting a quick evaluation run (regress-vs-suite) against alpha-stable-v1 vs alpha-quant-2026 to quantify quality delta. If stable is fine, we'll keep pinned until kernel fix.

jess: cust-acme replied: reduced errors after 2m, wants root cause and timeline. sharing CTO contact to eng-sre.

samir: creating incident ticket INC-2498765432, linking to alert and changes. actions: (1) quiesce variant, (2) emergency quotas applied, (3) notify customers, (4) revert PR and tests.

console-bot: snapshot: traffic now 100% alpha-stable-v1 in us-west-2. emergency quotas applied to keys [customer:acme, customer:fastbeta, customer:pilotX].

marta: note for postmortem: add regression test for KV-cache path for long sequences and add canary-run with synthetic load during kernel rollouts.

samir: handing off pager to ryan at 2498765900. ryan, please continue monitoring for 2 cycles and own postmortem. I'll be available for context. :thumbsup:

ryan: ack, taking pager. will triage logs + open postmortem doc. tagging eng-sre and eng-runtime.

incident-bot: ALERT RESOLVED (mitigation applied). closing signal at 2498765900. Follow-ups: postmortem, revert PR, model quarantine review.

samir: closing thread for active mitigation. follow-ups in INC-2498765432 and PR#4521. thanks all. :raised_hands:
